name: Trash Trek Simulator
detailed_description:
Trash Trek Simulator is a first-person survival game set in the filthy streets, where despair mixes with dark humor. As a homeless outcast with no future, you start from nothing — just you, a dirty backpack, and a trash-fueled dream.

Your mentor John gives you one piece of advice:

“Dig through trash, trade garbage, survive, and thrive in the ruthless world of beggar economics.”

⸻

👤 Singleplayer: A Quick Dive into Chaos

• The singleplayer mode serves as a light tutorial — learn to move, scavenge, and survive.

• Accept your first challenge from John, head to the dump, collect, sort, and sell what you find.

• After the tutorial, return — and you’ll be ready for multiplayer or the brutal life on the streets.

• Even though it’s a solo mode, the city breathes, trash piles up… and the characters have their secrets.

• 🔒 The main story is in development — for now, just listen to the city’s quiet hum.

⸻

🌐 Multiplayer: A Trashy Alliance (with a Hint of Rivalry)

• In multiplayer, players cooperate to complete a shared challenge — gather enough valuable junk as a team.

• But everyone plays a little selfish — hiding valuable finds, withholding rewards, or taking advantage of others’ inattention.

• Scavenge, carry your loot into the team or personal inventory, and decide who really deserves your help…

⸻

🚨 SBS Guards: Enforcers of the Clean Order

• The city has rules. Your trash scavenging isn’t part of the plan.

• Once spotted by an SBS guard, the chase is on. Run or end up in jail.

• Got a baseball bat? You might fight them off… or at least feel a bit better.

⸻

🃏 Side Content

• 🎰 Casino: Blackjack, slot machines, scratchcards. Got luck… or not.

• 💃 Disco: Music, dance it out, roleplay with your friends.

• 👊 NPC Beatdown: Grab a bat and see who’s really dangerous — them… or you.

• 🏕️ Camp Aesthetics: Buy items, place them, improve your camp and boost reputation and comfort.

• 🧼 Showers & Deodorants: Clean yourself, gain authority (and lose the stench). The shower lady will still yell at you though.

⸻

📈 Survival Systems

• Comfort: Increased via food, booze, and camp decor.

• Energy: No food = no sprinting or jumping.

• Authority: Lost by vomiting, gained through hygiene and deodorants.

• Inventories: One temporary (for challenges), one permanent — guard it with your life.

• Minigames: Lockpicking, quick-time events, item RNG, and haggling with the Pawner.

⸻

🧠 Absurd Philosophy

“I once owned a skyscraper, but traded it for the scent of a dumpster.”

— Jožo, local philosopher and lifelong alcoholic

⸻

🔮 What’s Next

• New cities, new camp zones, new challenges.

• Wanted system, police, deeper NPC interactions.

• Story and reputation-based quests.

• More items, features, and core gameplay enhancements.

⸻

    Future Expansions

• More locations, more dumpsters, more cities—players can look forward to new areas to explore and loot in future updates.

⸻

🌟 In Trash Trek Simulator, You Are the Chaos-Maker

Will you fight the system, or get crushed like a soda can between the trash?

Your world is full of junk. And you’re ready to shine in it.

Will you rise from the streets or embrace the chaos? In Trash Trek Simulator, the choice is yours.

short_description: Explore the world through the eyes of a homeless scavenger, rummaging through junkyards, outsmarting security, and turning trash into cash. Play solo or in chaotic multiplayer, where quick hands, smart moves, and a good sense of humor make all the difference. Laugh, hustle, and survive!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or better
  • Additional Notes: Requires stable internet connection for multiplayer mode.

  • Additional Notes: Requires stable internet connection for multiplayer mode.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains themes of petty crime, such as scavenging from dumpsters and avoiding security guards. Players can use non-lethal weapons to temporarily disable pursuers in order to escape. The game also includes occasional references to alcohol consumption and mild crude humor. There is no graphic violence or explicit content.
